bloqueadaTexto: Right now neither of you sees the other's comments or photos. Their prices stay on the map: they're data about bars.

suspenderTexto: Suspending takes effect immediately: they can no longer add prices, comment or rate. What they already added stays — to take down something specific, do it from the bar.
